description:
Have you ever wondered what is really happening behind the things you use every day?

Welcome to **WTF**. ⚡🌎

We explain technology, the Internet, science, and the invisible systems behind the modern world through animated, visual, easy-to-understand videos.

Together with **Gael**, you’ll discover what really happens when you tap a button, use Wi-Fi, watch a video, talk to AI, pay with a card, or use any of those technologies that seem simple… until you look underneath.

🎬 Animated videos  
🧠 Easy-to-understand explanations  
🌐 Technology, Internet, AI & science  
⚡ Quick Shorts and full videos  
🤯 Curiosities that make you go: WTF

Because behind the most ordinary things, there’s usually something incredible happening.

**WTF — Understand how the world you use every day actually works.**
